record.question: In September 2009 one Chief Minister was killed when his helicopter got crashed. The Chief Minister belonged to which state?
record.explanation: Answer A: Andhra Pradesh. The deceased Chief Minister was Y. S. Rajasekhara Reddy of Andhra Pradesh. The President's 3 September 2009 condolence identifies both his name and his state. Reference: https://presidentofindia.nic.in/smt-pratibha-devisingh-patil/press_releases/president-condoles-passing-away-andhra-pradesh-chief. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
